items.title: Pay repair invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Rechnungsstellung auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: This is a private-law payment deadline set by a company, not an authority, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself (Rechnungsstellung = 01.07.2025). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (01.07.2025) is not counted, so counting starts 02.07.2025. Ten days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on 11.07.2025, a Friday, which is a normal working day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Due date: 11.07.2025 (to arrive in time for a bank transfer, sending by 10.07.2025 is advisable per § 675s BGB, but the legal due date is 11.07.2025).

warnings: The IBAN printed (DE08 3705 0198 0007 9792 00) is well-formed and belongs to a German bank, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account — confirm the payee details against a previous invoice or the workshop's known contact information before paying, especially since invoices are a common target for fraud (e.g. intercepted mail with a swapped IBAN).
